forecast_reason.summary: Expected to fall about 17.6% in 30 days. Biggest reason: recent trend (-15.6%).

drivers.name: Recent trend
drivers.why: Over the last 30 days the price fell 22.4% once the usual seasonal effect is taken out. The forecast carries that direction forward but lets it fade each day, so about 65% of it is kept over the next 30 days.

drivers.name: Season
drivers.why: In the seasonal pattern (from 9 years of prices) the price is usually 0.2% higher in 30 days' time (Dec) than now (Nov).

drivers.name: Last few days' average
drivers.why: Today's price is above the last 5 days' average, and the forecast counts a one-day jump only half, so it starts 2.7% lower than today.

forecast_reason.range: 80% of past misses fell inside -32.0% to -1.8% at 30 days, so that is the likely range.
forecast_reason.trust: Tested on 244 past dates: off by 11.5% on average at 30 days, vs 10.3% for "price stays the same" - it is NOT better than no-change here, so read it as a range, not a number. Direction right 55% of the time.
forecast_reason.blind: It reads only the price's own trend and season. It can't see US interest-rate moves, war or crisis news, central-bank buying, or an import-duty change in the Budget - news like that can move the price outside the range.

rules.english:
2026-11-27 Silver - WAIT (score 0 of 5): If buying: Buy only what you need now.  If holding: No clear edge - sell only if you need the cash.
Why: The reasons cancel out: the price is in the cheap part of the year's range, but a stronger rupee makes it cheaper in India.
What would change it: Turns BUY if the price falls to Rs 1,23,875 (-11.5%). Stays WAIT even if it rises 15%.
How sure: Low. Past WAIT days (716 since 2017): within 3% 30 days later on 32% vs 32% of all days -> edge -1 points.
Price: Rs 1,39,972 per kg (Rs 1,44,171 with 3% GST); 7 days +8.6%, 30 days -16.3%. 30-day outlook Rs 1,15,262 (likely Rs 95,187 - Rs 1,37,482).
Saving for years: GO SLOW - The long-run signs are weak right now: keep the small regular buys, but avoid one big purchase now. Because the long wave is down (below the 200-day average). Not counted (its record disagrees): Change over 12 months.
rules.telugu:
2026-11-27 వెండి - వేచి ఉండండి (స్కోరు 0 / 5)
ఎందుకు: కారణాలు ఒకదానికొకటి సరిపోతున్నాయి: ధర ఈ ఏడాది పరిధిలో తక్కువ భాగంలో ఉంది, కానీ రూపాయి బలపడటం వల్ల భారత్‌లో ధర తగ్గుతుంది.
ఏది మారిస్తే మారుతుంది: ధర Rs 1,23,875 (-11.5%) కి తగ్గితే కొనండి. ధర 15% పెరిగినా ఇదే సూచన.
నమ్మకం: తక్కువ. గతంలో WAIT రోజుల్లో (716 రోజులు) 30 రోజుల తర్వాత 32% సార్లు ధర 3% లోపే మారింది; ఏ రోజైనా 32% (తేడా -1).
ధర: కిలోకు Rs 1,39,972 (GST తో Rs 1,44,171); 7 రోజుల్లో +8.6%, 30 రోజుల్లో -16.3%. 30 రోజుల అంచనా Rs 1,15,262 (Rs 95,187 - Rs 1,37,482).
ఏళ్ల తరబడి దాచుకునేవారికి: నెమ్మదిగా కొనండి - దీర్ఘకాల సంకేతాలు ఇప్పుడు బలహీనంగా ఉన్నాయి: చిన్న క్రమమైన కొనుగోళ్లు కొనసాగించండి, ఇప్పుడు ఒకేసారి పెద్ద మొత్తం కొనకండి. కారణం: దీర్ఘకాల ధోరణి కిందికి ఉంది (200 రోజుల సగటు కింద).
